_comment: NOT-MUSIC GATE. Málaga Live is a LIVE MUSIC site, but several venues we track publish their WHOLE programme — Auditorio Municipal de Benalmádena (operabenalmadena / tickets.oneboxtds.com) and Marenostrum Castle Park (marenostrumfuengirola.com) list theatre, dance, comedy, magic and children's shows next to the concerts, and the weekly LLM sweep takes the lot. Deleting such a row from the calendar does NOT hold: the next sweep re-adds it from the same venue page. So exclusions live here and are applied by build_site.py on EVERY build, as a gate running BEFORE the phantom / Fever-unbuyable / receipt gates. Matching is on the normalised act name (lowercase, accents stripped) and is a SUBSTRING test. IMPORTANT: set 'venue' whenever the phrase could belong to a real act somewhere else — a personal name ('David Navarro', 'José Tejada') or a common phrase ('La Granja') must be scoped to the venue, or a genuine gig elsewhere would be silently dropped. Omit 'venue' only for names distinctive enough to be safe anywhere. NOT blocked, deliberately: CABARET 2.0 at the same Benalmádena venue IS live music (Sofia 2026-07-29). This gate's drops appear in the build log's [gate] block. NOTE (2026-08-04): this file is now shipped by the canonical deploy-site.bat (added to its Website scp list), so a normal deploy applies any edit here — no separate genre-fix bat needed. This gate also carries OWNER CONTENT-POLICY removals (e.g. 'love of lesbian', DLR 2026-08-04), not only not-music rows; the log prefix 'not live music' is cosmetic for those.

blocked.why: Comedy hypnosis show, not live music. Sofia 2026-07-28. Auditorio Municipal de Benalmádena publishes its full programme; the sweep took it.
Dance performance, not live music. Sofia 2026-07-28. Same venue programme as above.

Magic show ('MAGO ORBIT PRESENTA ACERO 2.0 – SOHAIL MÁGICO', 16 Aug 2026, Marenostrum Castle Park, Fuengirola). Not live music. Sofia 2026-07-29. Unscoped: 'mago orbit' is a distinctive stage name, safe to block anywhere.

Children's show ('CANTAJUEGO – EL PAYASO TALLARIN', 23 Aug 2026, Marenostrum Castle Park, Fuengirola). It does contain music, but it is a kids' entertainment brand rather than a live-music gig — Sofia ruled it out 2026-07-29. Unscoped: 'cantajuego' is a registered brand name, safe anywhere.

Not live music (23 Aug 2026, Auditorio Municipal de Benalmádena). Sofia 2026-07-29. SCOPED TO THE VENUE ON PURPOSE: 'la granja' is a common Spanish phrase and could plausibly be a band name elsewhere — unscoped this would risk dropping a real gig.

Not live music (6 Aug 2026, Auditorio Municipal de Benalmádena) — a Spanish comedian of this name tours the venue circuit. Sofia 2026-07-29. SCOPED TO THE VENUE ON PURPOSE: it is a personal name and a musician could share it; unscoped this would risk dropping a real gig.

Not live music (16 Aug 2026, Auditorio Municipal de Benalmádena). Sofia 2026-07-29. SCOPED TO THE VENUE ON PURPOSE: personal name, same reasoning as David Navarro. Note the matcher strips accents, so this also matches 'José Tejada'.

OWNER CONTENT-POLICY REMOVAL at DLR's direction 2026-08-04 (NOT a genre judgment). DLR ruled this act's name inappropriate for the ML calendar and wants it excluded — originally the 29 Aug 2026 show at Auditorio Starlite, Marbella. Removing the calendar row does not hold (the weekly sweep re-adds a real event), so it is gated here on every build. Unscoped: 'love of lesbian' is a distinctive band name, safe to block anywhere. NOTE: this reuses the not-music gate, so the build log's [gate] line will read 'not live music' — that prefix is cosmetic; the real reason is the owner content-policy exclusion recorded here.

CANCELLED BY THE SELLER — removed at DLR's direction 2026-08-17 (NOT a genre judgment). 'KREAM feat. Alvama Ice', 29 Aug 2026, Auditorio Municipal Cortijo de Torres, Málaga. Ticketmaster.es event 1231184919 shows 'This event has been cancelled. Ticket sales have stopped.' — browser-confirmed 08-15 and again 08-17. No alternative seller exists, so the card had a Tickets button that could never sell. Ticketmaster.es is a TRUSTED HOST (shipped unfetched), so the daily verifier can never auto-drop it; this gate is the only durable removal. DATE-SCOPED + VENUE-SCOPED so a future KREAM date anywhere else still publishes normally.

NO SELLER LEFT — removed at DLR's direction 2026-08-17 (NOT a genre judgment). 'Bresh, la fiesta más linda del mundo', 12 Sep 2026, Plaza de Toros de Torremolinos. Browser-confirmed 08-17: the Torremolinos council page carries no buy control at all; the promoter's own Plaza Paraíso programme now advertises a DIFFERENT event in that 12 Sep slot ('Tardeo Argentinos ATR'); the Fourvenues Bresh event page 404s; and Atrápalo lists it 'NO DISPONIBLE'. Every reachable route says it is off sale or replaced, so no correct link exists to ship. DATE-SCOPED + VENUE-SCOPED: Bresh tours constantly, so a future Bresh date must still publish.

WRONG-DATE DUPLICATE — removed at DLR's direction 2026-08-17 (NOT a genre judgment). The site was showing this show TWICE: 22 Aug (as 'I Noche Flamenca del Compás', onebox select/2697427) and 23 Aug (as 'NOCHE FLAMENCA DEL COMPÁS', onebox events/51613). Browser-confirmed 08-17 on the seller's own SESIONES tab: event 51613 has exactly ONE session, SÁB 22 AGO 22:00, €30, 'Disponibilidad media'. There is no 23 Aug show — the venue's blurb reads 'Del 22 al 23 de agosto' (a festival window) and that range was read as a second night. The 08-15 re-date fixed the map entry but the stale calendar row survived. THE DATE SCOPE IS THE WHOLE POINT: an act-only block would also have deleted the REAL, on-sale 22 Aug gig. Keep the 22 Aug card; this removes only the phantom 23 Aug one.

NO ONLINE TICKETING — removed at DLR's direction 2026-08-17 (NOT a genre judgment; this IS live music). Zarzuela 'Agua, azucarillos y aguardiente', Teatro Lírico Andaluz, 25 Aug 2026, Casa de los Navajas, Torremolinos — III Festival Lírico. Re-confirmed in the browser 08-17: the council event page states the date, the €10 single unnumbered price and the two shows (21:00 / 22:30), but carries NO buy control and NO ticket-seller link; seats are sold IN PERSON ONLY at Viajes Pinsapo (Plaza de la Nogalera). It was the one remaining card of 36 whose Tickets button offered a visitor no purchase path at all, which is exactly what the daily ticket audit exists to eliminate. REVERSIBLE: delete this entry to list it again if the owner would rather show it as an information-only card. DATE-SCOPED + VENUE-SCOPED so a future zarzuela of the same title elsewhere (it is a standard repertory piece) still publishes.

DEAD SELLER PAGE - removed 2026-08-19 by the daily click-test (NOT a genre judgement). The card's own Fever link (feverup.com/m/182969) REDIRECTS to plan 405944 'Candlelight: Long Live the Rock Legends', which shows 'We love this experience, but no tickets are available at the moment' - wrong event AND unbuyable. The real plan, feverup.com/m/677232 'Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA' at Salon Linares Anantara Villa Padierna, offers only two sessions in its date selector - dom 11 oct 2026 and sab 09 ene 2027 - so NO 22 Aug session exists at any seller. Browser-verified 2026-08-19. Scoped to venue+date so the October/January runs are unaffected.

NOT A 2026 EVENT and no way to buy - removed 2026-08-19 by the daily click-test (NOT a genre judgement). The card's Tickets link opens the Ayuntamiento de Nerja press release 'Antonio Cortes inaugura la nueva temporada del Centro Cultural con un concierto inedito', DATED 10 SEPTIEMBRE 2024, with no ticket page and no buy control (browser-verified 2026-08-19). DLR already ruled this entry off the site on 2026-08-15 as a 2024 press release read as a 2026 event; the weekly sweep has re-created it. Scoped to venue+date so a genuine Antonio Cortes gig elsewhere is unaffected.

DUPLICATE CARD - removed 2026-08-19 by the daily click-test (NOT a genre judgement). 27 Aug carried Canela Party TWICE: 'Canela Party - Day 1 (Baiuca, Basement, Unknown Mortal Orchestra...)' at Recinto Ferial de Torremolinos, and this 3-day aggregate row 'Canela Party 2026' billed at 'Plaza de Toros de Torremolinos'. Same festival, same seller (ingresse.com/canela-party-2026/, browser-verified 2026-08-19 with Thu 27 / Fri 28 / Sat 29 Aug all bookable). The aggregate is dropped rather than the day cards because the day cards carry the correct venue (ingresse states Recinto Ferial de Torremolinos) and the per-day line-ups; days 1-3 remain live. Flagged for a ruling on 2026-08-18 and closed here.
